ambiguities.reason: Bearing retainer and main/transmission-bearing lock washer both list 6 Nm, but differ in printed Loctite condition. Same abbreviated 0019050121S occurs in ENGINE CASE, CRANKSHAFT and both transmission assemblies; require functional/diagram or procedure confirmation before choosing condition.
CLUTCH has generic 0025050166 at callout10 and spring retainer at36. Adjusting-ring versus spring-retainer function changes 6 to8 Nm; do not map by M5 dimensions.
Pressure/suction pump cover table says M5x16; catalog generic bolts include0025050146S. Full bolt labels and functional placement needed; do not resolve through PN pattern.
ambiguities.resolution: Both official lubrication cover-screw callouts8/26 explicitly M5x14, while owner pressure/suction pump-cover table says M5x16. Do not attach M5x16 torque to these occurrences without corrected or procedure-specific OEM evidence.

ambiguities.reason: Shift lever table M6x16; catalog callout2 0024060156S description abbreviated HH collar. Full description/dimension corroboration needed.
ambiguities.resolution: Official group58163 full label explicitly M6x15 for0024060156S; owner table says M6x16. Do not normalize away this discrepancy.

ambiguities.reason: Water pump has multiple cover/balancer attachments with different thread treatments (blank,222,243). Generic labels alone insufficient to choose; duplicate cover occurrences appear in CLUTCH COVER too.
ambiguities.resolution: Water pump assembly callouts13/14/15 resolved using full labels and diagram. CLUTCH COVER mixed-function callout20 remains unsafe as a global occurrence mapping: seven M6x25 occurrences include water-pump and clutch-cover locations with different thread treatments.

limitations: All59 engine table rows transcribed; does not establish every physical bolt is covered.
Mappings apply only to exact assembly/callout/part occurrence; never join by thread size or part number globally.
Catalog labels are frequently abbreviated; unmapped facts remain useful by component name but are not safe exact part assignments.
No bolt tightening sequence, reuse policy, removal instructions, tools or torque-angle stages inferred.
Paid repair manual is needed for remaining procedural and mapping gaps, not for reading these owner-manual engine torque facts.
